how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Current Volume traded of  the selected Instrument  for that particular day till the time when the condition is checked. So at any point in time if this keyword is used then it will return total traded volume in that particular instrument up to that instance of time.

![Example](./images/img-1631705028.png)

Like in the above example you can check whether volume traded for nifty futures is > 1.5 Lakh for the current day. If suppose condition is checked at 2 pm, it will return the total volume traded from 9:15 am till 2:00 pm
